div.h2: Do you want to allow another person to discuss this federal tax return with the IRS?
div.p: The IRS calls this person a third party designee.

div.h2: Tell us about your third party designee.
Ask your designee to create a 5-digit personal identification number (PIN).
div.p: Your designee can pick any 5 digits. They will need the PIN to identify themselves to the IRS.

modal-content.p: You can appoint a person that the IRS is allowed to contact about your federal tax return. This authorizes the IRS to call that person to answer any questions that may come up during the processing of your federal tax return.
A third party designee can also:

ul.li: Give the IRS any information that is missing from your federal tax return
Call the IRS for information about the processing of your federal tax return or the status of your federal refund or payments
Receive copies of notices or transcripts related to your federal tax return, upon request
Respond to certain IRS notices about math errors, offsets, and federal tax return preparation

p.modal-link: What’s the Presidential Election Campaign Fund?

fg-set.question: Do you want to designate to be paid to the Presidential Election Campaign Fund?

modal-dialog.modal-heading: What’s the Presidential Election Campaign Fund?

modal-content.p: This fund helps pay for presidential election campaigns. The fund reduces candidates’ dependence on large contributions from individuals and groups and places candidates on an equal financial footing in the general election. The fund also helps pay for pediatric medical research.
